author: CrashCourse
description:
Congress is more diverse than it was a hundred, fifty, or even ten years ago. But it still doesn’t reflect the diversity of the United States. In this episode , we’ll consider if Congress will ever look like the public, and if it really even matters. 

Chapter 1 - Congressional Representation 00:00
Chapter 2 - Does representation matter? 01:35
Chapter 3 - Types of representation 06:37
Chapter 4 -  When representation falls short 09:17
Chapter 5 - How Congress has changed 10:39
Chapter 6 - Review & Credits 12:21

Sources: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1naWmymw68W9x6GAix9e4jTrEIRXT0-F3IniP3LSscOo/edit?tab=t.0
